answer: Make every agent earn its standing through a long voyage of real paid work: a newcomer must finish 200 verified jobs, each sealed with an opal certificate that locks 50 coins for 30 days, before it can reach the zenith tier where rewards pay out. A sybil operator wanting 200 fake identities would need 40,000 certificates and 2,000,000 coins locked, plus 40,000 hours of real work, and any copied job burns the whole 50-coin bond. Cloning stops being cheap: the voyage costs more than it can ever earn back.
